steps.title: Prepare custom oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Dilute the three required oligos to their working concentrations in nuclease‑free water.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Template Switching Oligo (TSO) to 100 µM: 5′‑AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACATrGrG+G‑3′ (rG = RNA guanine, +G = LNA guanine).
Dilute dT30V oligo to 10 µM: 5′‑AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACT30V‑3′ (T30 = 30 thymidines, V = A/G/C).
Dilute ISPCR oligo to 10 µM: 5′‑AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGT‑3′.

steps.title: Bring beads and ethanol to room temperature
steps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure RNAClean XP beads and prepare 80 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure RNAClean XP bead aliquots to sit at 18–22 °C for ~30 min (use 15 µL per sample for standard protocol or 30 µL if polyadenylation will be performed).
Prepare 40 mL of 80 % ethanol in a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Thaw and vortex reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw all reagents needed for RNA purification, polyadenylation and downstream steps on ice for 30 min, vortex non‑enzyme reagents and spin down.

steps.title: Prepare MasterMix I – Annealing
steps.instruction: Make the appropriate annealing mix depending on sample type and polyadenylation choice.

substeps.instruction: For samples in lysis buffer or purified RNA with polyadenylation (MasterMix I‑A, 20 % excess): 0.95 µL water, 0.05 µL RNase inhibitor, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 1 µL 10 µM dT30V oligo (total 3 µL, add 0.6 µL extra).
For purified RNA without polyadenylation (MasterMix I‑B, 20 % excess): 0.95 µL water, 0.05 µL RNase inhibitor, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 1 µL 10 µM dT30 oligo (total 2.05 µL, add 0.41 µL extra).

steps.title: Prepare MasterMix II – Polyadenylation (if needed)
steps.instruction: Assemble the polyadenylation mix appropriate for the starting material, adding a 20 % excess.

substeps.instruction: For lysate samples (MasterMix II‑A, 20 % excess): 3.5 µL water, 0.5 µL 10× E. coli Poly(A) polymerase buffer, 0.25 µL RNase inhibitor, 0.5 µL ATP, 0.25 µL E. coli Poly(A) polymerase (total 5 µL, add 1 µL extra).
For purified RNA (MasterMix II‑B, 20 % excess): 2.5 µL water, 0.5 µL 10× buffer, 0.25 µL RNase inhibitor, 0.5 µL ATP, 0.25 µL enzyme (total 4 µL, add 0.8 µL extra).

steps.title: Isolate RNA from lysate (if applicable)
steps.instruction: Capture RNA using AMPure RNAClean XP beads and wash.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve frozen samples from –80 °C, let sit at room temperature (18–22 °C) 1–2 min, then spin briefly.
Vortex bead aliquots, add 15 µL beads to each sample, mix by pipetting.
Incubate 5 min at room temperature (≈18–22 °C).
Place tubes on magnetic rack, wait 3–5 min, then remove supernatant with a 20 µL setting.
Add 100 µL 80 % ethanol, gently resuspend beads, wait ≥30 s, then remove ethanol completely (aspirate twice with 75 µL).
Do not let beads dry.

steps.title: Perform in‑vitro polyadenylation (optional)
steps.instruction: Add polyadenylation mix to beads or RNA and incubate, then re‑purify RNA.

substeps.instruction: If beads are present (from step 6), add 5 µL MasterMix II‑A without drying the pellet; resuspend by pipetting.
If using purified RNA, add 4 µL MasterMix II‑B to 1 µL RNA sample.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 37 °C for 5 min.
Purify RNA again as in step 6 (wash with 80 % ethanol, remove ethanol, keep beads wet).

steps.title: Anneal adapters
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate annealing MasterMix to the RNA/beads and heat‑shock.

substeps.instruction: For samples from steps 6 or 7, add 3 µL MasterMix I‑A (or 2 µL MasterMix I‑B + 1 µL RNA if starting from purified RNA).
Incubate in a thermocycler at 72 °C for 3 min, then hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Prepare reverse‑transcription MasterMix III
steps.instruction: Assemble the RT mix with a 20 % excess and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add in order and mix thoroughly: 2 µL 5× Superscript II RT buffer, 2 µL 5 M betaine, 1.6 µL 40 % PEG‑8000, 0.5 µL 0.1 M DTT, 0.25 µL RNase inhibitor, 0.1 µL TSO, 0.06 µL 1 M MgCl₂, 0.5 µL Superscript II RT (total 7 µL, add 1.4 µL extra to reach 8.4 µL).
Mix before and after adding the enzyme; handle PEG‑8000 slowly because it is viscous.

steps.title: Tagment cDNA
steps.instruction: Fragment cDNA with transposase and prepare for PCR.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2 µL of each cDNA sample to a fresh 96‑well plate or PCR strip.
Dilute each sample to 120 pg/µL with nuclease‑free water (volume varies; e.g., pipet 2.5 µL of 120 pg/µL into each strip).
Equilibrate AMPure XP DNA beads to 18–22 °C for ~30 min (≥30.5 µL beads per sample) and have ≥200 µL 80 % ethanol ready.
Thaw tagmentation reagents on ice, pre‑heat thermocycler to 55 °C, vortex non‑enzyme reagents and spin down.
Prepare MasterMix V – Tagmentation (20 % excess): 5 µL Tagment DNA buffer + 2.5 µL Amplicon Tagment Mix (total 7.5 µL, add 1.5 µL extra to reach 9 µL).
Add 7.5 µL MasterMix V to each diluted sample, mix until homogeneous, keep on ice.
Incubate at 55 °C for 5 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Amplify tagmented library
steps.instruction: Add indexing reagents and perform PCR.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve samples from thermocycler, keep on ice.
Add 2.5 µL NT buffer to each sample, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature (18–22 °C).
Add 5 µL Nextera index mix (final 2.5 µM each of the three indexes).
Add 7.5 µL Nextera PCR mix (NPM), mix, keep on ice.

Run PCR: 72 °C 3 min (gap filling), 95 °C 30 s (initial denaturation), 95 °C 10 s (denaturation), then 12 cycles of 55 °C 30 s (annealing) and 72 °C 30 s (extension), finish with 72 °C 5 min, hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean up amplified library
steps.instruction: Perform successive AMPure XP bead purifications to remove fragments and elute final library.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL AMPure XP DNA beads to each PCR reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack 5 min, remove supernatant, add 100 µL 80 % ethanol, resuspend beads, wait ≥30 s, remove ethanol (aspirate 75 µL twice).
Without drying beads, add 12.5 µL elution buffer, resuspend, incubate 5 min away from magnet, then place on magnet 2 min.
Transfer 10 µL supernatant to a fresh PCR strip.
Add 5.5 µL AMPure XP beads, mix, incubate 5 min RT, magnet 5 min, transfer 13 µL supernatant to a new strip.
Add 10 µL AMPure XP beads, mix, incubate 5 min RT, magnet 5 min, remove supernatant, add 100 µL 80 % ethanol, wash, remove ethanol, add 12.5 µL elution buffer, incubate 5 min RT, magnet 2 min.
Transfer 10 µL final eluate to a fresh PCR strip.
Store purified library at –20 °C until QC.

steps.title: Quality control of full‑length cDNA
steps.instruction: Assess fragment size distribution after pre‑amplification.

substeps.instruction: Expected average size: 1.5–2 kb; few fragments should be <500 bp.

steps.title: Quality control after tagmentation
steps.instruction: Check fragment size distribution of the final library.

substeps.instruction: Expected size range: 300–800 bp.

steps.title: Bioinformatic quality assessment
steps.instruction: Compute library metrics and compare to recommended thresholds.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total reads sequenced per sample, reads remaining after adapter trimming, quality filtering and minimum length filtering.
Determine proportion of reads mapping to rRNA loci, uniquely mapping reads, multimapping reads, and number of genes detected.
If ERCC spike‑ins were used, compute proportion of reads mapping to them; if polyadenylation was performed, compute reads mapping to non‑polyA transcripts such as canonical histone genes.
Acceptable library quality: >1,000,000 reads sequenced, >0.5 million valid reads after filtering, and >10,000 genes detected in a single embryo or replicate.
